entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes. I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed, I was really looking forward to it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. It's for the Apex long-sleeve jersey.
Okay, I see the order here. And just to be clear for my notes, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. I always get a medium from you, I've been a loyal customer for years, but this one is just way too tight across the shoulders. I can barely move in it.
I understand. Sizing can sometimes be inconsistent between different collections. I see you received this 36 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy. I was really hoping I could still get my money back. I really needed this money...

Not to worry. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh, thank goodness. You know, I was thinking about an exchange, but I think I'd just feel safer with a refund right now. I was counting on that money for something else.

Of course. A full refund it is. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging if you can, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Thank you, I really appreciate it. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
